scores.Biological Plausibility_reason: Required items were Mapk4, K2P/leak potassium channels, and HCN channels. Reduced resting conductance could plausibly increase input resistance, but the proposed MAPK4-specific control of these channels is an unsupported extrapolation from generic MAPK biology, and perfect numerical identity should raise concern for target leakage rather than direct regulation.
scores.Grounded Mechanistic Synthesis_reason: Mapk4 was connected to input resistance through proposed downregulation or internalization of K2P leak and HCN channels. The response did not identify a MAPK4-specific intermediary, while the morphology and VIP/LAMP5 explanation remained a separate alternative rather than part of the same mechanism. A ceiling of 5 was applied because multiple alternative mechanisms were proposed without explaining how they are related or discriminated.
